title: 40 additional PSR/SPSR compatibility cases: new geometry and controlled input defects
scope: Fresh pinned serial C++ solves, instrumentation neutrality and independent CUDA reconstruction. Fixed raw/centered field, scaled-gradient and isovalue budgets; exact active/support keys and input processing. Mesh-derived inputs and explicitly artificial defects; implementation compatibility, not surface-quality evaluation.
archive_policy: Complete generated fixtures retained in ignored persistent storage; every member SHA-256 and size verified before removing the uncompressed duplicate. Source downloads and raw archives are not bundled in Git.
timing_scope: Generation timings are provenance only; concurrent correctness work means these are not performance measurements.
